title: JR10 · Discuss Your Experience and Evaluate the Employer

blocks.text: ДО ЗАПИСИ. Открой урок https://www.skool.com/salesforce-automation-mastery-2005/classroom/c65db7d0?md=735dadda9dfb46daa04c204c01de3f17. Подготовь только синтетические данные и исходное состояние упражнения. Покажи карточку опыта: context, personal action, outcome, limitation. Дай короткий ответ на камеру. Затем выбери вопросы команде о review, deployments и ownership, привязанные к будущей работе. Запиши финальный пример отдельным коротким проходом, затем верни исходное состояние. Если нужная функция недоступна, запиши объяснение схемы и явно назови эту границу.
КАМЕРА. Короткое вступление, затем экран. Действия ниже выполняй между соответствующими репликами. Для долгой сборки ставь CameraCue на паузу: ⌘⇧Space.
Here is our practical task. Prepare three experience stories and a focused set of employer questions.
МОНТАЖ ПОЗЖЕ. Вставь 6–10 секунд подготовленного результата. Это preview результата; пошаговую сборку покажи дальше без пропуска важных решений.

By the end, you should be able to show the result and explain how you checked it. Stories contain a specific action and evidence, not only personal qualities. Team contributions and limitations remain accurate.

cues.label: 02 · Prepare stories with a real decision

blocks.text: ЭКРАН. Раздел «Prepare stories with a real decision». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Experience questions often ask about a difficult problem, feedback, collaboration or a mistake. Choose real events that you can discuss without exposing confidential information. A training or volunteer example can be useful when you label the context. The strongest story contains a decision you made, the information available at the time and what you learned from the result. For example, you may have built a flow that worked for one test record but failed when several records were updated. Explain how you reproduced the failure, identified the repeated work, changed the design and checked the result. Do not replace the technical detail with “I worked hard and solved it.” The interviewer needs to understand how you approach uncertainty.

ЭКРАН. Раздел «Keep responsibility and outcome clear». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Use a short structure: situation, responsibility, action, result and reflection. Describe the situation only far enough to make the problem understandable. Spend most of the time on your actions and reasoning. If other people helped, identify their contribution. If the result was mixed, explain what improved and what remained unresolved. Prepare three stories: one successful delivery, one diagnosis or mistake, and one response to feedback. For each, write a one-sentence lesson that changed how you work. “I now test a mixed batch before calling validation complete” is more concrete than “I learned to be careful.” Practise telling the story in two minutes, then allow follow-up questions.

cues.label: 04 · Ask questions that reveal the actual work

blocks.text: ЭКРАН. Раздел «Ask questions that reveal the actual work». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

An interview also gives you information about the role. Ask about the first projects, the balance between configuration and code, the release process, the development environments and how code review works. For a more senior role, ask who owns architectural decisions, incident response and technical debt prioritisation. Choose questions that matter to your target responsibilities rather than reading a long generic list. Connect a question to something in the description. “You mention integration ownership. Does that include monitoring and handling failed messages, or mainly building new endpoints?” is more useful than assuming the phrase has one meaning. Ask for examples where possible. The answer may reveal a fit, a learning opportunity or a mismatch; record it without treating one imperfect answer as a complete judgment of the employer.

cues.label: 05 · Use the conversation to make a decision

blocks.text: ЭКРАН. Раздел «Use the conversation to make a decision». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

After the interview, record what you learned about responsibilities, support, expectations and the next stage. Separate stated facts from your interpretation. “The team said developers rotate incident support” is a fact from the conversation. “The team is probably chaotic” is an interpretation that needs more evidence. If a practical condition is still unclear, note a follow-up question. Review whether the role still matches the target from JR01. A role with a desirable title may involve work you do not want, while a differently titled role may offer the development you need. You do not need to decide everything during the call. The aim of your questions is to replace assumptions with information that supports a thoughtful decision.
For the practical work, choose real events with clear ownership.

ЭКРАН. Вернись к результату упражнения. Покажи evidence, а не зелёный статус без деталей. Затем открой практическую задачу и остановись перед готовым решением.

Now pause the video and try the exercise yourself. Prepare three experience stories and a focused set of employer questions. Stories contain a specific action and evidence, not only personal qualities. Team contributions and limitations remain accurate. Employer questions clarify responsibilities you care about.
Before you finish, answer this question in your own words. Should a mistake story hide the mistake?
ПРИ ЗАПИСИ. Пауза 4 секунды. Не показывай ответ раньше вопроса. Затем открой объяснение и сравни его с проверяемым результатом.

No. Explain the response, verification and lesson while respecting confidentiality. Save your work with the expected and actual results. If a check was not run, say which one remains and what you would need to run it.
